title: Annex A.3 - Internal organization
description: Working paper for Annex A.3: AI roles and responsibilities, reporting of concerns.

sections.title: AI roles and responsibilities (A.3.2)
prompts: Verify AI-specific roles are defined with explicit accountabilities.
Confirm separation of duties for high-risk AI changes.

sections.title: Reporting of concerns (A.3.3)
prompts: Confirm a reporting channel exists for AI ethical/safety concerns.
Sample whether reported concerns were investigated.

checklists.text: Whistleblower channel exists and is communicated.
Sampled concern reports show investigation and outcome.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through what happens when a developer reports an ethical concern about an AI system.
Show us anonymized records of recent concerns and how they were resolved.
